title: D3b: delegation ceiling and self-expiring credentials for coordinator-to-subagent dispatch
description: Operator ruled YES on D3 (2026-08-17). Two properties, enforced structurally rather than by policy: no identity may delegate more privilege than it holds; and a subagent credential carries a TTL the subagent cannot extend. Coordinator-to-subagent dispatch is unconstrained today. W-002 already carries an expiry, so make the expiry the rule rather than the instance. Write down the honest limit: under D-17 every agent runs as the same OS user, so this bounds ACCIDENT and makes overreach attributable, and does not bound an adversary. Pin it with a test that tries to exceed the ceiling and shows what is and is not stopped.
